# graviteeam_applications (Data Source)

Searches Gravitee AM applications with page or cursor pagination

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graviteeam_applications" "example" {
  domain_id         = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  query             = "customer"
  application_types = ["WEB", "SERVICE"]
  status            = "enabled"
  limit             = 25
  sort              = "updatedAt"
  direction         = "DESC"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain

### Optional

- `application_types` (List of String) Application type filters: WEB, NATIVE, BROWSER, SERVICE, RESOURCE_SERVER, or AGENT
- `cursor` (String) Cursor supplied by a previous cursor-mode response
- `direction` (String) Sort direction: ASC or DESC (default: DESC)
- `expand` (List of String) Application relationships to expand
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of applications to return (default: 50)
- `owner_email` (String) Application owner email filter
- `page` (Number) Zero-based page number (default: 0)
- `pagination_mode` (String) Pagination endpoint to use: page or cursor (default: page)
- `query` (String) Free-text application search query
- `sort` (String) Application field used for sorting (default: updatedAt)
- `status` (String) Application status filter: enabled or disabled

### Read-Only

- `result_json` (String) JSON string containing the complete application search response
